USVD Consultants Pty Ltd (ACN 666 075 065) ABN: 80 993 362 158 is a recruitment company having office at Bella Vista NSW 2153.

Our client Star Steel Structures & Frames Pty Ltd (SSSF), ABN: 52 630 055 248 located at: 138 Dunheved Cct, St Marys NSW 2760 is a Premier Steel supply and installation company. It is a 100% Australian owned company that provides customisable solutions in high-quality reinforcing mesh, structural steel, and prefabrication services, specializing in eco-friendly construction materials. They focus on delivering durable, moisture-resistant, and heat-resistant products made from 100% recyclable steel. With a commitment to sustainability, Star steel ensures a 48-hour turnaround for quotes while adhering to Australian construction standards. Their products are designed for maximum efficiency and reliability, serving the needs of construction professionals who value quality and eco-conscious solutions.

Due to the business growth and expansion plans, USVD is now looking to recruit Welder(s) in their Operations team on a permanent full-time basis. We are seeking an experienced Welder or maybe two, to join our operations team on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for fabricating, joining, and repairing metal components and structures using a range of welding techniques, working from technical drawings and specifications to produce high-quality, structurally sound welds in accordance with the relevant Australian standards.

Position: Welder
No of positions: 02
Reports to: Operations Head / Supervisor
Location: 138 Dunheved Cct, St Marys NSW 2760
Annual salary range: AUD $80,000 - $85,000 base + Super (for a 38-hour work week)

As a Welder, your main duties and responsibilities includes:
•	Ensuring all work is carried out in compliance with WHS regulations and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Cutting, bending, shaping, joining and repairing metal components of iron and steel structures, boilers, pressure vessels and pipes.
•	Studying blueprints, drawings and specifications to determine job requirements.
•	Selecting, cleaning and preparing metal stock.
•	Cutting marked-out metal sections and shapes using hand tools, flame cutting torches and metal cutting machines.
•	Shaping and bending metal sections and pipes using hand and machine tools and by heating and hammering.
•	Aligning parts to be joined using hand tools and measuring instruments.
•	Joining metal sections using various welding techniques, bolting and riveting.
•	Examining welds for width of bead, penetration and precision.
•	Finishing products by cleaning, polishing, filing and bathing in acidic solutions. 
•	Cleaning and smoothing welds by filing, chiselling and grinding.
•	Selecting and applying appropriate welding processes (manual metal arc, gas metal arc, advanced welding techniques) based on material and job specifications.
•	 Assembling fabricated components in line with technical drawings.
•	Applying safe welding practices and maintaining accurate weld records.
•	Operating fixed and mobile load-shifting equipment at workshop as required.
•	Working safely and effectively within manufacturing and engineering environments, complying with WHS and environmental sustainability requirements. 
•	Performing engineering measurements, inspections and quality checks on completed welds and fabricated items.
•	Ordering materials and planning work activities to meet production schedules.
•	Organising and communicating information with supervisors and team members. 
•	Using hand tools, power tools and computing technology relevant to fabrication and welding tasks.

Qualification & Licences:
•	Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade – Welder (First class) preferred.
•	At least 5 years of proven work experience in the above job role. 
•	Sound welding experience in manual / advanced metal arc welding & Gas metal arc welding process. 
•	Well experienced of WHS requirements, particularly in manufacturing and steel fabrication environment. 
•	Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications.

Skills:
•	Strong organizational and time management skills 
•	Excellent attention to detail 
•	Ability to multitask and physically fit
•	Process and results driven 
•	Team player; collaborative 
•	Resilient, patient and adaptable 
•	Enthusiastic, self-motivated 
•	Proactive & hard-working

Additional information: 
•	Ability to work outside of normal business hours on occasion when delivering key orders. 
•	Ability to travel interstate if required

Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to: 		Manager
Job Title: 		Electrical Engineering Technician
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 Days

Position Overview: Mygration is engaged to source the following position for our client
Our client is a leading innovator in the design, fabrication, and installation of high-quality steel structures and electrical systems for industrial and commercial applications. With a strong focus on engineering excellence, safety, and precision, they deliver cutting-edge solutions across various sectors, including infrastructure, energy, and manufacturing.

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineering Technician to join their dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting the design, installation, and maintenance of electrical systems for heavy machinery, substations, and industrial control systems. You will work closely with engineers and technologists to ensure all electrical installations meet industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical skills and a passion for electrical systems within an industrial and structural engineering environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design & Documentation:
• Prepare detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and layout plans for industrial installations, including substations, switchgear, motor control systems, and cabling networks.
• Develop wiring diagrams and termination schedules for control panels used in heavy machinery & manufacturing and automation systems.

Technical Support:
• Assist electrical engineers in the design, testing, and optimization of electrical systems for machinery & manufacturing and structural projects.
• Troubleshoot and diagnose faults in PLC-controlled systems, including servo drives and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

Testing & Analysis:
• Conduct electrical tests, perform complex calculations, and analyse data to validate system performance.
• Perform insulation resistance (IR) testing, earth continuity checks, and thermal imaging on high-voltage equipment.

Cost Estimation:
• Assist in estimating material quantities, costs, and project timelines.
• Evaluate supplier quotations for electrical components (e.g., circuit breakers, contactors) to ensure cost-effective procurement.

Quality Assurance:
• Inspect electrical installations and finished products for compliance with specifications.
• Verify that all electrical work adheres to AS/NZS 3000 and IEC standards before commissioning.

Installation & Maintenance:
• Assemble, install, calibrate, and repair electrical equipment, including protection relays and metering devices.
• Perform preventive maintenance on industrial motor control centres (MCCs) to minimize downtime.

Workshop Operations:
• Undertake workshop duties, including wiring, testing, and modifying electrical assemblies.
• Fabricate and test custom control panels for machinery integration.

Research & Development:
• Contribute to R&D initiatives by assisting in experimental programs.
• Assist in the testing and integration of renewable energy systems (e.g., solar inverters) into industrial power networks.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:
• Trade Certification or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
• Proven experience in electrical drafting, machinery wiring, or industrial electrical systems and manufacturing fabrications.
• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical) for schematic and layout design.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform technical calculations and interpret test data.
• Knowledge of industry standards, including AS/NZS 3000 and electrical safety regulations.
• Hands-on experience with motor controls, switchgear, PLCs, and protection systems is highly desirable.
• Workshop & fabrication skills, including the ability to assemble and troubleshoot electrical components.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and project teams.
• At least 2 years of Full-time on the job work experience.

WHY APPLY?
• Work with a forward-thinking company at the forefront of industrial and structural engineering.
• Engage in high-impact projects involving cutting-edge electrical systems.
• Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
• Competitive remuneration and a supportive team environment.

If you are a motivated Electrical Engineering Technician with a passion for precision and innovation, we encourage you to apply! Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Please note: We are recruiting on behalf of our client. All applications will be treated with confidentiality.

Where there's life, there's Mercy. 

Where there's care, there's You.

Through the battles and the breakthroughs, we're there. Where will you be?

For over a century, our incredible teams have provided care for people when they need it most. Our people feel great pride in this, and they value the security and stability we offer. But it also means so much opportunity - to build on all that's gone before, to grow your impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

As a for-purpose organisation with over 10,000 dedicated, compassionate people, we continue to offer more services and deeper care than ever before. With Mercy, you'll have the chance to make an impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

At Mercy Health, it's all about taking what we have and making it better. 

To do that, we need you. 

Join us at Mercy Health, and help our teams deliver even greater outcomes. 

About the opportunity

Our Birthing Suite midwives are highly skilled, and passionate about providing evidenced based, women centred care.

Work a rotating roster including Morning, Afternoon & Night duty shifts, with the opportunity to upskill and work 0930-1800 triaging induction bookings and performing cervical ripening for induction of labour. Should you prefer to work only night duty shifts, this will also be considered. 

We support our midwives to grow and develop their skills to be able to provide hollistic care in birthing services.

What you'll bring

You're resilient, compassionate and have a whole lot of heart. Most importantly, you are committed to delivering exceptional patient-centred care.

To thrive in this role, you will have:

Previous birthing suite experience

Level 2 or above RANZCOG practitioner status

Competence to perform IV Cannulation, Balloon Catheter insertion for induction of labour, perineal suturing, and waterbirth (or working towards these skills)

Knowledge of managing high risk, complicated pregnancies and birth, but also possess the skills and desire to facilitate physiological birth where possible

About you: 

You are approachable, compassionate and contribute to a positive team culture. 

Excellent clinical, time management, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to adapt and problem solve.

You are compassionate and demonstrate a flexible and positive approach to effective patient care

You will also be required to provide evidence of, or in the process of obtaining:

A current Police Record Check and Working with Children Check.

Proof of current influenza vaccination and other vaccination status consistent with public health orders.

AHPRA Registration
